fact: The EITI 2020 report (signed 9 June 2022) states Burkina Faso has adopted an open data policy, with BODI created by joint order 2015-0043 of 15 February 2015 and a national open data portal data.gov.bf.
title: Rapport ITIE 2020
publisher: Initiative pour la Transparence dans les Industries Extractives au Burkina Faso
